For a Bengaluru apartment, switching costs mean the hassle/cost of moving, storing, maintaining, or replacing the bike.

Alternative	Price	Switching cost
Cult X-Bike with Table	₹12,999	Low: foldable, easy to store; magnetic resistance suits apartments.
PowerMax BS-130	₹11,499	Medium: sturdier 8kg flywheel, but less convenient to move/store.
LETS PLAY Recumbent Bike 6kg	₹21,998	High: larger footprint; better comfort, but costly to relocate if you move apartments.

Current Indian listings put comparable compact bikes well below ₹25,000. 
ProductHunter.in
+1

Bottom line: Choose the foldable option if apartment space or a future move is the main concern; pay extra for the recumbent design mainly if seating comfort matters more than portability.
